channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stanley Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stanley Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
Pop on what Spurs like about Stanley Johnson:

“He’s a tough competitor. He’s defensive-minded. He’s strong. He's a big wing. And he plays hard.”

Gregg Popovich on Stanley Johnson, Dec 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: LeBron James on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
Harrison Faigen:LeBron, on Stanley Johnson:

“People forget that he was a top 10 pick in our league... He's a guy who's hungry.”

LeBron James on Stanley Johnson, Jan 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Raptors Nick Nurse on Stanley Johnson finding a niche:

“He's learned our defensive system... I have to find a place for him in the offense.”

Nick Nurse on Stanley Johnson, Oct 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
#Pistons Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson:

“It’s his consistency and getting his mojo and his swag back ... I believe in Stanley. That’s the first thing I told them in the interview. There’s something with Stanley Johnson that’s there – and we have to bring it out of him.”

Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson, Jul 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
#Pistons Casey on competing:

“Our time is now...the key is the summer for our young guys, with Stanley, Henry and Luke.”

Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson, Jun 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
Casey:

“Stanley Johnson is the best matchup for No. 23 in Cleveland that there is.”

Dwane Casey on Stanley Johnson, Jun 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Reggie Jackson on Stanley Johnson, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Reggie Jackson on defending Giannis:

“We trust in what we’re doing and trust in Stanley’s ability to cover him and we’ll go from there.”

Reggie Jackson on Stanley Johnson, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nov 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
“Kyle Korver hasn’t had as many good games this year but the guy really knows how to play basketball and how to move without the ball and got Pope a couple times.“I don’t mean that in a negative sense or to be sarcastic on Stanley. He got an education tonight; we’ve never really put him on a guy like that. It’s different; you’ve got to be really locked in. he was trying; there was no lack of effort anywhere.”

Stan Van Gundy on Stanley Johnson, Jan 1, 2017. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy on Stanley Johnson going back to #Drive more:

“I don’t anticipate him ever going down when we’re playing. That’s not for sure.”

Stan Van Gundy on Stanley Johnson, Dec 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: LeBron James on Stanley Johnson
item.description:
James said, according to Cleveland.com.

“I'm not having an individual match-up with Stan, or an individual matchup with Stanley [Johnson] or any other Stan they could possess. It's about getting my guys ready and that's all that matters.”

LeBron James on Stanley Johnson, Apr 20, 2016. Source: Booth Newspapers.
